implementation: the owning component or contract document selected by touched paths
review: the frozen Issue contract and AC-to-evidence mapping
staging: references/actions-sls-fallback.md only for an existing synthetic logging run when direct SLS credentials are unavailable
production: the separately authorized production capability reference

fast: format and diff checks for touched components
review: one PR-wide managed Grok review admitted only for the final complete frozen diff
one in-flight review per PR with a freeze write barrier and deterministic join
full deterministic CI joined with the review result
staging: read-only prerequisite receipt before environment ownership; for report intake use node scripts/report_intake_preflight.mjs with the explicit target and exact CI tuple when that repository capability is available
current PR tuple and required checks revalidated before and after ownership
exact-revision rollout, functional acceptance, bounded SLS evidence and rollback disposition

resources.cluster_selection: explicit kubeconfig and context; never a shell nickname
resources.production_default: forbidden unless the assignment explicitly sets production=true

risk_probes: For new deployed components, exercise first publication without a prior image, unchanged-source revision stamping, and rollback tool-cache miss; check image, Secret and storage prerequisites before the environment lock.
For at-most-once publication, exercise a lost success response followed by bounded reconciliation.
For paginated reconciliation, prove a full page budget is inconclusive rather than proof of absence.
For retry or requeue changes, preserve monotonic evidence that a side effect may already have occurred.
For schema upgrades, open a prior-version database and verify the migrated invariant.
For auth, credentials or privacy changes, test deny-by-default and negative data-flow paths.
